newsitem.title: USA: Caliber unit sees rise in package volume.
newsitem.headline: Caliber unit sees rise in package volume.

text.p: RPS Inc, a unit of motor freight carrier Caliber System Inc, said its package volume through the end of the day Monday had increased to 1.5 million packages a day, a 20 percent increase over normal volume.

The company stopped taking on new customers as of July 1, committing instead to accept increased package volume only from its existing customers, many of whom use both United Parcel Service of America Inc and RPS.
"Business shippers are in a bind right now," said Bram Johnson, vice president of Marketing and Strategic Planning for RPS.

"The reality is that no single carrier could possibly assume all UPS's traffic. We knew our capability was limited, and months ago we committed to using all our resources to help our own customers first. It would serve no purpose to take on new customers that we couldn't service properly," Johnson said.
A nation-wide strike against UPS entered its second day on Tuesday with no talks scheduled between management and the Teamsters union representing UPS workers.

Operations at UPS, the nation's largest package delivery service,were paralyzed as 185,000 workers walked off their jobs after last-ditch contract talks between the company and the International Brotherhood of Teamsters broke down late Sunday.
